visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a black shirt with a ruffled cream trim, holds a large cardboard platter filled with sliced roasted crispy pork, lettuce, and tomatoes. She is in a restaurant with warm lighting and a wooden interior. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the food box as the woman picks up a piece of lettuce. She smiles broadly while demonstrating how to wrap the meat. (3) The woman takes a large bite of the lettuce wrap, chewing with a happy expression. She uses a white napkin to wipe her mouth. (4) The scene cuts to a different indoor location with a yellow t-shirt. She holds a bowl of purple and yellow sweet potato balls. The background features indoor greenery and bright, natural indoor lighting. (5) She eats a sweet potato ball using chopsticks, laughing and looking off-camera at someone else. (6) The woman continues to talk and laugh animatedly, using hand gestures while leaning forward towards the camera. The video ends with her laughing loudly.
